tools.name: check_product_allergens
tools.description: Check a product's ingredient list against the allergies of one or more people in a household. Catches allergens listed under other names (e.g. "arachis oil" for peanut, "casein" for milk, Latin plant names in cosmetics) and does not let "free from" claims hide a real ingredient. Covers food and cosm

tools.name: lookup_ingredient
tools.description: Tell which allergens, if any, an ingredient name belongs to, e.g. "sodium caseinate" -> milk, "Prunus amygdalus dulcis oil" -> tree nuts, "DMDM hydantoin" -> formaldehyde releasers.

tools.name: list_supported_allergens
tools.description: List the allergens this service can check (food and cosmetic), with the other names users may type for them.
